title: Jamaican Chicken Curry
description: A flavorful and spicy Jamaican-inspired dish featuring chicken in a rich curry sauce. Serve with rice or naan for a delicious meal.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the spring onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the curry, tomatoes, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped spring onion if desired.
Serve with rice or naan for a delicious meal.
